title: sps-provider.yaml
description: The static facts of a provider package for the 1.0 Python interface. The file sits in the Python package that the provider's entry point names, so that tools can read it without importing the package's code.

provider_id.description: The stable provider id; the name of the entry point and the id that discovery's `provider.id` uses.

spec_version.description: The newest 1.x minor that this package implements, as `major.minor`.

credential_fields.description: The values that the provider's API needs. The constructor receives a mapping from each name to its value.

secret.description: True when the value must never be logged or returned.

account_identity.description: False when the field only tunes how the provider is served (a mode or a default), not which account it is. A deployment that records an account by a fingerprint of its credential fields (a route id, a document it vouches for the account) leaves such a field out, so setting or adding it does not make the account a new one.

required_for_managed.description: True when a deployment that runs the provider on its own account must also supply this value, although a consumer with its own account may leave it out (a field that is not `required`). Such a deployment reads it into the account's identity, so a document it vouches for that account binds to it.

default.description: The value used when the consumer gives none. Only for a field that is not secret.

public_prefix.description: How the values of a secret field start, such as `dtn_`. Only for a secret field.

forgets_ended_sandboxes.description: True when the provider's `list` stops showing a sandbox as soon as it is destroyed, so an empty listing can never show that a sandbox which has ended did exist. A consumer that must prove a sandbox never existed (for example to release a hold for a create whose answer was lost) then cannot rely on an older ended sandbox still being listed.

discovery_confirms.description: The `resources.needs` conditions that `discovery()` reads from the provider for each account. For each name, an account's discovery states every fact that needs it at the static discovery's value only when the package has read from the provider that the account meets it, and states a narrower value otherwise. A consumer may take such a condition as met from the account's discovery. It takes no condition left out of this list as met from a discovery.

api_domains.description: Every host name that the package connects to: an exact host name, or a suffix with a leading dot that matches every host under it.
